jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Business Process Reengineering (BPR) and Sales Engineering
jobs.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.  
  
Sales and Operations Engineering is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's global operations, sales, and supply chain. The team connects the systems that move products from factory to customer - bridging sales platforms with the operational infrastructure that keeps Apple running at scale and ensuring Apple's technology and business priorities move in lockstep.  
  
**Description**  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale enterprise back-end systems that power critical Apple products and services. You will develop, document, and maintain production code in Java - from architecture through implementation - while independently owning complex, often ambiguous technical problems and driving cross-functional solutions with minimal guidance.  
  
You’ll be hands-on across the stack: designing APIs and microservices, working with core Java internals, optimizing data layer performance, and ensuring secure, reliable deployment. You will interface directly with business leaders, application owners, other developers, and project managers to take projects from inception to completion, and you’ll be responsible for delivering on commitments on time.  
  
Beyond individual contribution, you will act as a key technical mentor on your team, shaping architectural direction and raising the technical bar for those around you - extending your influence across related disciplines and organization-wide initiative
